info.description: Local API for Label Studio Prelabeling Dataset Versioning. It wires Label Studio to Backblaze B2 as source and target storage, runs local pre-label runs, verifies annotations and cuts immutable COCO releases. This contract documents the sample's local API, not a hosted public endpoint.

post.description:
Validate a declared upload and hand back a presigned PUT.

The browser uploads the image straight to `labeling/raw/<project>/` on B2
with the returned URL, so the bytes never traverse this API. Size and
content-type are signed into the URL (see the service). A "Sync from B2"
on the project then turns the new image into a Label Studio task.
Confirm an object just uploaded directly to B2 is valid and visible.
